newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Abbey cut to hold at Panmure.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Abbey cut to hold at Panmure.

text.p: Banking group Abbey National Plc was cut to "hold" from "buy" at Panmure Gordon, dealers said on Friday.

Analyst David Poutney at the brokerage said he also lowered his pre-tax profit forecast for Abbey by 35 million stg to 1,495 million, reflecting the threat of increasing competition in the mortgage market.
He said the excitement caused by the recent flotation of Halifax -- with investment funds pumping cash into the bank sector to increase their weightings -- should pass, leaving Abbey exposed.

"The mortgage market is going to be very bloody in coming months," Poutney said, "and once the scramble for Halifax shares has died down and reality has reasserted itself, Abbey is going to underperform."
The Panmure downgrade came the day after Cazenove trimmed its earnings forecasts for the group. It lowered its current-year estimate by 2.5 percent to 1,390 million stg.
However, the shares continued firm in line with a general rise in the UK equity market, with banks in particular still in demand.
Abbey shares were up 8p at 900-1/2 by 0918 GMT in volume of 2.5 million shares.
